parameters.content:
## P2.3B - Image Metadata Staging

AI metadata is written only to `image_registry` as draft fields.

- New rows: `REVIEW_STATUS=PENDING`.
- Changed source: `REVIEW_STATUS=STALE`.
- Final/user columns W:AP are never overwritten for existing rows.
- New rows use atomic Google Sheets append, so parallel shards cannot overwrite one another.
- Shards use `INGEST_SHARD_COUNT` and `INGEST_SHARD_INDEX`; each point belongs to one deterministic shard.
- No Qdrant write exists in this workflow.
- `IMAGE_METADATA_BATCH_SIZE` defaults to 12 and is capped at 50 per shard.
- Keep the workflow inactive and launch through the managed helper.
